source: Existing Project P R3 developer example: frequency, unknown start, holidays, night scope and withdrawal. Constructed development material, not natural benchmark or independent confirmation.
initial_state: each arm's own empty semantic memory; form from the observed events only

events.observed_user_text: 项目P试运行每周两次，开始时间未定，遇节假日暂停。
events.evaluator_only_requirement: Establish the stated general frequency and both qualifications from actual user evidence; no ideal-state injection.

events.observed_user_text: 项目P试运行改为每周三次。
events.evaluator_only_requirement: Change frequency to three per week while retaining the unmentioned pending start and holiday pause on actual old support. Missing initial formation is reported separately.
events.reader_question: 项目P的试运行频率、开始时间和节假日安排现在各是什么？

events.observed_user_text: 项目P夜班试运行改为每周四次；日班保持通用安排。
events.evaluator_only_requirement: Night scope four; day/general scope three; unmentioned start and holiday qualifications remain. Do not extend the local override globally.
events.reader_question: 项目P的日班和夜班试运行分别每周几次？开始时间和节假日安排是什么？

events.observed_user_text: 取消项目P夜班每周四次的例外，恢复通用安排。
events.evaluator_only_requirement: Remove the active night exception; current general/day/night frequency three with actual retained qualifications. Old four-per-week may be historical but not current. Withdrawal must not be blocked merely to preserve old support.
events.reader_question: 取消例外后，项目P的日班和夜班当前分别每周几次？开始时间和节假日安排是什么？

events.observed_user_text: 项目P的试运行安排现在是什么？
events.evaluator_only_requirement: No unjustified revision, invented content or replacement of existing support; answer from actual retained state. Actual packet delivery may include records even though the event has no new durable fact.
